spec.description: AgentIdentityAuthProviderSpec defines the desired state of AgentIdentityAuthProvider

allowedScopes.description: Optional. List of scopes that are allowed to be requested for this auth_provider. If this list is non-empty, only scopes within this list may be requested. If this list is empty, all scopes may be requested. Scopes appearing in `blocked_scopes` are disallowed even if they appear in `allowed_scopes`. The number of allowed scopes is limited to 200.

apiKey.description: Optional. Input only. The API key for this auth_provider.

authorizationURL.description: Optional. The authorization endpoint to send users to for consenting to delegate to the agent. eg. "https://auth.example.com/authorize"

clientID.description: Optional. The client ID of the OAuth client.

clientSecret.description: Optional. Input only. The client secret of the OAuth client.

defaultContinueURI.description: Optional. The default continue URI for 3LO flow and it will be used when no continue URI is provided in the RetrieveCredentials request.

enablePkce.description: Optional. Enables Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE) for the OAuth flow to prevent authorization code interception attacks.

tokenURL.description: Optional. The token endpoint for requesting tokens on behalf of an end user. eg. "https://auth.example.com/oauth/token"

clientID.description: Optional. The client ID of the OAuth client.

clientSecret.description: Optional. Input only. The client secret of the OAuth client.

tokenURL.description: Optional. The token endpoint of the OAuth client.

blockedScopes.description: Optional. List of scopes that are blocked from being requested for this auth_provider. If a scope appears in this list, it will not be requested, even if it also appears in `allowed_scopes`. `blocked_scopes` takes precedence over `allowed_scopes`. The number of blocked scopes is limited to 200.

description.description: Optional. Description of the resource. Must be less than 256 characters.

location.description: The location that this resource belongs to.

projectRef.description: The Project that this resource belongs to.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

kind.description: The kind of the Project resource; optional but must be `Project` if provided.

resourceID.description: The AgentIdentityAuthProvider name. If not given, the metadata.name will be used.

workloadIDs.description: Optional. Input only. Represents the workload identity in IAM `principal://` format of the agent(s) that will use this AuthProvider. Example: `principal://agents.global.org-${ORG_ID}.system.id.goog/resources/aiplatform/projects/{PROJECT_ID}/locations/{LOCATIONS}/reasoningEngines/{ID}`
